newsitem.title: MEXICO: Three banks bid for Mexico's Banpais - paper.
newsitem.headline: Three banks bid for Mexico's Banpais - paper.

text.p: Three banks have presented bids to buy the intervened Mexican bank Banpais, the daily Reforma said Tuesday.

Citing sources close to the process, Reforma said Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA, Banco Mercantil del Norte, a unit of Grupo Financiero Banorte, and Banco Invex are the three competing to obtain 81 percent of the share capital of Banpais.
Banpais was taken over by the government in March 1995 on grounds of internal fraud. The government is re-selling the bank through auction.
Reforma said the result will be announced in the first half of September.
